title: Chemically sodiated iron disulfide as a high-capacity charge-storage host with cation- and anion-sited redox
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01337B, Communication
Hunter O. Ford, Jeffrey W. Long, Meghanne E. Tighe, Debra R. Rolison, Ryan H. DeBlock
Straightforward low-temperature chemical synthesis of Na-ion storing compound Na2FeS2 (>250 mAh g−1) that exhibits anion- and cation-sited redox.
